Image of an iPhone with the new Bluesky trending widget at the top of the screen. 

The widget reads:

Trending on Bluesky

1. Local cat elected mayor
Whiskers McGee wins by a landslide after promising more sunbeams, fewer Mondays, and a nap tax.

2. Bluesky users turn 39
All of them, at once, on the same day. Experts recommend stretching before your next post.

3. "Skeet" added to the dictionary
Editors say they tried calling it a "post" for three years, but nobody listened, so here we are.

4. Group chat agrees on dinner
Eleven friends picked a restaurant in under an hour, a feat historians are calling a first.

5. Summit settles 4 types of users
After 72 hours of high-stakes talks, negotiators agree on four types, then split into a fifth.
